besluite.fout: 'gegroei' for a dance taking shape copies English 'grew'; Afrikaans says 'ontwikkel'.
besluite.rede: Same meaning, more natural verb, and kept consistent with changes 2 and 6.

besluite.fout: 'onder trekarbeiders gegroei' is the same calque of 'grew' as in block one.
besluite.rede: Natural verb for a dance's origin, meaning unchanged, consistent with 1 and 6.

besluite.fout: Bare 'om' after 'goudmyne' can make a Grade 5 reader expect 'om te' and stumble.
besluite.rede: 'rondom' says 'around' unambiguously and the place stays the same.

besluite.fout: 'kom daarna kyk' can be read as 'come afterwards to look'.
besluite.rede: 'kom dit sien' points clearly to the dance, like 'skoolspanne dans dit' before it, with the same meaning.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb (hulle dans / 'n kitaar speel).
besluite.rede: Required punctuation under AWS 2017; nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: 'Ballet het in Europa gegroei' uses the same calque of 'grew'.
besluite.rede: 'ontwikkel' is the natural verb and keeps the three blocks consistent.
The fronted 'Langs mekaar' reads naturally and echoes the heading; the reorder is a lateral move that now suggests the dances stand physically side by side.

besluite.fout: 'die meeste ballet' copies English 'most ballet'; Afrikaans needs the countable plural with 'die meeste'.
besluite.rede: 'In die meeste ballette' keeps the qualifier and the claim exactly and reads naturally.

besluite.fout: The dance itself is made to stamp, which jars; it is the dancers who stamp.
besluite.rede: Same claim with the right agent, matching 'gumboot-dansers skop ook hoog' later in the block.

besluite.fout: 'Ballet probeer lig lyk' has the dance trying, which only people can do.
besluite.rede: Same meaning with the right agent, and keeps the pair parallel with change 9.
'Dit is die klem en nie die enigste ...' is ordinary natural Afrikaans; the comma version is only different.

besluite.fout: 'bly in sy karakter' breaks the fixed expression 'in karakter bly' and can read as keeping his own personality.
besluite.rede: A real fault, but it is inside a glossary definition, which only the writer may change for every lesson at once.
